step.act1_prison.completion_flavor: The data stream ends before it becomes a translation. No language, no mathematics, and no human model can hold the whole of it. But the archive is not random: routes, containment records, warnings, and fragments of an identity are buried together in the noise. The cell was built for something. It is empty now. And the terminal has sent the first answer back into the dark.
step.act1_prison.description: The door has opened onto a facility built beneath Mars. Descend through the silent prison, restore the systems that still answer, and reach the deep cell at the bottom. The cell is empty, but one terminal is alive. Extract its data; it may tell you whether the prisoner left by choice, by force, or long before anyone on Mars knew this place existed.
step.act1_prison.ready_message: The archive handoff is ready. Take the recovered archive to the Research Officer at Alpha Centauri's Science Port for an independent reading. The work will wait for you; the signal will not become clearer on its own.
step.act1_prison.title: The Prison Below
step.epilogue_reward_bar.completion_flav: The old man spends an evening in your hold with a cargo strap and a marker. A tenth of every hull you ever fly is now space no scanner reads.
step.epilogue_reward_bar.description: Return to the Barkeep on Earth and share the archive. The bar pays in things no ledger tracks.
step.epilogue_reward_bar.dialogue.barkee: You did the runs, you moved the crate, you carried the cell through Sol with every scanner reading you. So here is your pay. Every hull has dead space - seams the builders never meant to use. The old man will walk you through lashing yours. From today, a tenth of whatever you carry rides where no scan finds it. The archive stays between us - and one day you tell me what is out there.
Share the archive, learn the hold
step.epilogue_reward_bar.title: The Bar's Payoff
step.epilogue_reward_lab.completion_flav: The credentials go through. Mercury, Sirius, Alpha Centauri, Procyon C - every station posts you contracts now, frontier rates from the first day. Somewhere in the Lab the archive is being segmented layer by layer.
step.epilogue_reward_lab.description: Return to the Research Officer at Mercury and share the archive. The Lab pays in work: contracts posted to you at any station in the network.
step.epilogue_reward_lab.dialogue.resear: You kept it intact. Every layer - navigation, network, warning, whatever else is still folded inside. Leave it with us and we will read it properly. In return: credentials. Every station in the network will post you contracts - specimen runs, site recovery, frontier rates. The work pays, and the work matters.
Share the archive, take the credentials
step.epilogue_reward_lab.title: The Lab's Question
step.epilogue_reward_merchants.completio: 8,000 posted, 12,000 returned. The Guild keeps its ledgers balanced and takes the archive to the vaults. Somewhere past the Luyten Line, the readings are still changing.
step.epilogue_reward_merchants.descripti: Return to the Guild Master on Earth and share the archive. The Guild honors its debts - your bond, with its return.
You brought back something older than every ledger we keep, and it cost us a cutter to get you there. The bond pays out with its return - that was always the deal. Leave the archive with us and the Guild remembers who carried it.
Share the archive, collect the bond
step.epilogue_reward_merchants.title: The Guild's Due
step.epilogue_reward_militia.completion_: Your name goes on the warrant list. The board at the Captain's office posts work to you from here on - frontier rates, no frontier trip required.
step.epilogue_reward_militia.description: Return to the Militia Captain on Earth and share the archive. He pays in the only currency the Militia has: work. Warrants, posted to you, at frontier rates.
step.epilogue_reward_militia.dialogue.mi: You went through that door and came back with its records. That makes you a contractor I can post work to. I am putting you on the warrant list. My board will post to you from today - real targets, frontier rates, and every one you close counts with us. Leave the archive with me and we are square.
Share the archive, take the warrant
step.epilogue_reward_militia.title: The Captain's Price
step.prologue_open.description: Return to Mars. Open the door. Curiosity drives you forward.
step.prologue_open.title: The Door Opens
